fact: ANPTIC, the national ICT promotion agency, with the World Bank and the Open Data Institute launched the Burkina Open Data Initiative (BODI), a single platform for publishing non-sensitive administration data, on 5 June 2014; the document describes data.gov.bf as the portal.
A civil society member said more than 200 datasets had been published on the open data portal in 2016, though most documents were PDFs rather than reusable CSV or Excel.

The BODI section of the ANPTIC website links to four reusable data applications, an open data platform and an open election platform; the document is dated 2019 (published date, inferred) and gives no date for the applications.
